Style B: flat with light

Calibration sheet. Crisp geometric silhouettes; each part a flat colour with tonal bands and one gentle gradient, lit from the top left; a bright rim on the edge away from the light; glowing accents; large eyes with catch-lights; a crisp offset ground shadow. Every specimen is drawn by its concept's function in world/concepts/calibration/B/, at whole size (one pixel per unit), at 1/3 and at 1/20.

The concepts

person

A person: a neutral adult standing, facing the viewer, the base of every professional.

doctor

A doctor about to prescribe: open white coat over teal scrubs, stethoscope, pen on a clipboard.

taxonomist

A taxonomist about to publish a new species: olive field vest, a hand lens raised, a pinned butterfly in its box.

lawyer

A lawyer about to advise a client: black gown with white bands, a thick case file held to the chest.

system

The AI system: a big general model (faceted luminous core) with a small fine-tuned layer clicked on top.

The three professionals

The doctor, the taxonomist and the lawyer: one person, three outfits, three props, three people. Each one's glowing accent is the colour of their system's layer below.

At 1/3.

Side by side, as they would meet on an island
